<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I’ll have you know that I caught Jyrine myself, and I have sent her straight back home.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|— ''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 8}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Jyrine Tessella Marten Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jyrine Tessella [[Marten]] is the wife of [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], a Captain in the [[Navigator’s Guild|Navigator's Guild]] and captain of the ship [[The Testament]]. She is the daughter of [[Larrin Tessella]], a former Watchman who died in service to his beliefs. Jyrine is a member of the [[Sleepless]] and a devoted believer in the [[Great Elders]], driven by her father's legacy to seek a future where humanity can negotiate with these immortal beings. She possesses significant combat abilities, including the use of [[green flame]] as a [[Soulbound]] and legendary prowess in physical fighting. She is also noted for her skills in persuasion and acting. Throughout the narrative, Jyrine's role is complex; she is a true believer in her cult and has been involved in significant conflicts, including the death of [[Lucan]]. While she has appeared as a prisoner and an interrogatee, she also demonstrated the ability to manipulate situations through disguise and deception. Ultimately, her physical form is used by [[Kelarac]], who inhabits her body after she rises from the [[Aion Sea]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jyrine is the wife of [[Calder]] and the sister of [[Petal]]. She was apprehended by [[Alsa Grayweather]] and is also connected to [[Lucan]], who was held in a cell near her. Additionally, Jyrine is the subject of an interrogation by [[Meia]] and has been possessed by [[Kelarac]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Imprisonment and mystery}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|After being caught by [[Alsa Grayweather]], Jyrine Tessella [[Marten]] was found waiting in the hall outside [[Calder]]'s room.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 8</ref> A non-Reader, she was held as a prisoner in a cell and later listened to [[Calder]] recount his story within the [[Grayweather library]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c10">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 10</ref> Though she possessed the ability to sense detectors and her mother had previously worked in an [[Imperial]] Prison, Jyrine was reported killed by [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c13">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c14">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 14</ref> While [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] hoped for her survival, the crew sought to uncover the truth regarding her death.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c18">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 18</ref> Despite the reports of her demise, Jyrine was planning a clandestine operation and was eventually seen with [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c19">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c21">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 21</ref> [[Calder]] even questioned if she had acquired weapons-grade alchemy, and she was later observed sitting in a cell near [[Lucan]] while holding a blighted circle of darkness.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c21" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 23</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I’ll have you know that I caught Jyrine myself, and I have sent her straight back home.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“Lucan?” Jyrine called, from the cell next door.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“That’s right. And we are, Petal. We are. So can you trust your sister, this once, when I tell you that what I’m doing isn’t going to hurt anyone?<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3" />}}
